_about: Public-domain David Addison Harsha, American religious writer and biographer, for the Word Hoard: Thoughts on the Love of Christ, Wanderings of a Pilgrim, The Heavenly Token, and his lives of Philip Doddridge, James Hervey and George Whitefield. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
